_comment: ops/seo/tasks.json -- scheduled task definitions. Task Scheduler only ever passes a task NAME to run-task.ps1; every hyphenated flag lives here, because passing '--dry-run' through 'powershell.exe -File' is unreliable (an outer PowerShell expands it character by character into '- - d r y - r u n'). Keeping arguments in this file removes that failure mode entirely.

bing-coverage.description: Bing GetUrlInfo per-URL coverage. GetUrlInfo is rate limited as a TOKEN BUCKET, not by a daily quota: 1 req/s exhausts it at request 19, while 1 req/30s sustained 20 requests with no throttling. The interval therefore matters more than the count; 45s leaves margin. Throttling is recorded as a measurement failure, never as not indexed.

seo-daily.description: Daily submission: Google sitemap, Bing/Nave/Seznam IndexNow, plus the daily report draft. Currently disabled.

seo-email.description: Sends the daily report by SMTP. Runs the morning after the draft. Currently disabled.

gsc-daily.description: GSC URL-inspection batch plus merge into the Coverage workbook. Runs at 07:25; Google's browser-UI inspection quota stops it early.

gsc-dryrun.description: Validation only: checks that gsc_run.mjs can reach its inputs without launching a browser.
